name: Condensing Units
title: Refrigeration Condensing Units | Win Equipments
description: Refrigeration condensing units with compressor, condenser and controls on one base, assembled to order by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
card: Compressor, condenser and controls on one base, assembled to order for your evaporator.
lede: A condensing unit is the compressor half of a refrigeration system: the refrigeration compressor, condenser and controls on one base, piped to an evaporator in a cold room, process cooler or air handler. Win Equipments assembles condensing units to order.
applications: Process cooling with a separate evaporator
needs: Refrigeration capacity (kW or TR) and evaporating temperature
What the evaporator cools: cold room, process or air handler
Distance between the condensing unit and the evaporator

faqs.q: Why is there no standard model table?
faqs.a: These units are engineered to order around your duty, so we size and quote each one from your requirement rather than publishing a fixed model list. Send your requirement and our engineers will reply with a recommended configuration.
